QUESTION: can the Observatory separate interventional causal ancestry (clamp of an intermediate vs a same-distance non-ancestor clamp) from recoverable source content (held-out decoding), and refuse to count either as the other? Two parts, both preregistered before any confirmatory outcome: (I) INSTRUMENT QUALIFICATION on Cadmus's fixtures A (ancestry+content), B (structure without content), E (content without pathway), G (gapped), N (noise), the teleport counterfeit, PLUS a REQUIRED graded-content fixture (label written with probability p) showing decoder sensitivity at a TEST-4-like margin (~0.05 over chance) -- SELECTION.md s4 limit (i); (II) ONE NATIVE CONFIRMATORY QUESTION on RX (V1 as the shallow-tree comparison): on native paired units, how often do the engine's ATTRIBUTED descendants agree with INTERVENTIONAL descendants (clamp removes them, non-ancestor clamp does not), and among interventionally-real descendants is the source content recoverable (P3), i.e. is the native result 'ancestry with content', 'causal propagation without recoverable content', or neither? SELECTION.md s5's probe is a lead, not a result. Size N from measured throughput (~45 s per RX unit pair; budget <= ~1.5 core-h); new seed range declared disjoint from Cadmus's 0xC18A-0xC18E and every Aether range. REQUIRED from C-018: (a) the completeness contract (rso/completeness/, verify() before any verdict; manifest frozen with the preregistration); (b) the falsifiability table (rso/qualify/FALSIFIABILITY.md) for every claim-critical control, with audit() ok on dev data -- note Cadmus's own table already flags C1 locality as unable to fail natively (report as a sanity guard, not evidence) and C5 content-negative by construction; (c) the evaluator re-derives from native records (divergence masks, t0 identity, decode from stored features) and never trusts a derived producer field; ancestry correctness needs native replay -- state that trust boundary. Smallest adapter, ONBOARDING.md with lines reused / new / modified and the 'cost of detecting a false interpretation before the run' measure. Freeze before any confirmatory outcome; NO confirmatory run in this packet.
